title: Agent Spending Policy (draft 0.2)
description: A per-account spending policy as specified in spending-policy.md. Amounts are decimal strings in the smallest increment of the meter (spec §2.3). Addresses are canonical strings (EVM: 0x + 40 lowercase hex digits).

expiry.description: null = never. 0 is invalid on the wire (spec §2).

oneOf.description: Per-meter caps (spec §2.3). Absent or null = the meter is not examined. {} permits no meter.

uint.description: Unsigned integer as a decimal string: no sign, no leading zeros, ASCII digits. Binary encodings that cannot represent the value MUST reject it (spec §2).

address.description: Canonical address string. EVM: ^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$, never the zero address as an escalation co-signer. Other chains define their own canonical form.

keyRef.description: A public key reference for implementations that identify the escalation co-signer by key rather than address (the Python reference).

oneOf.description: CAIP-19 asset id; EVM tokens are eip155:<chainId>/erc20:<0x + 40 hex>.
Unit id. Registered names in spec §2.3.1; unit:x-... is private use.

meterId.description: A meter: a CAIP-19 asset id, or unit:<name>. Canonical form is lowercase. As with addresses (§2.1) the schema accepts any case for the asset form and implementations MUST canonicalise before comparing. A syntactically valid unit name that §2.3.1 does not register is schema-valid and MUST be refused at evaluation as a meter the policy does not permit.
